authors: C. Cornella, F. Feruglio, L. Vecchi
title: Gauge invariance and finite counterterms in chiral gauge theories
claim: Analytic expression for the finite one-loop counterterm restoring the Ward identities broken by the regulator in renormalizable chiral gauge theories (arbitrary group, general fermion representations), valid for a class of regularizations satisfying a few general properties; uses the background field method (background gauge invariance kept); extendable to scalars (SM) and to SMEFT; explicit SM one-loop finite counterterm in DREG with BMHV gamma5.
scheme: Background-field method; class of regulators incl. BMHV DREG.
symmetry_argument: Background gauge invariance + Wess-Zumino consistency fix the finite counterterm up to anomalies.

proved: One-loop finite counterterm formula for the stated class of regulators.

red_flags: One loop; background-field gauge invariance only.
